text:
maria gonzalez: Kicking off Q3 hosted API capacity planning thread. Proposal: introduce a 3-tier safety stock (3d / 7d / 21d of GPU-hours) and phase commitments to reduce tail risk. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

trevor liu: +1 on tiers. Can you share conservative / median / high forecasts so we can map tiers to real GPU counts? I ran a quick sim — attaching spreadsheet: https://internal/runs/q3-safety-sim (see tab 'phases')

maria gonzalez: quick ask — assume 10% holiday uplift window in Nov and 35% p50 traffic elasticity for new customers. Trevor, can you translate to GPU-hours per region?

trevor liu: draft numbers (30d avg -> GPU-hours/day): NA 22k, EU 9.6k, APAC 6k. Safety tiers -> 3d = NA 66k, EU 28.8k, APAC 18k; 7d and 21d scale linearly. These assume current batching/quant profiles.

ashley park: APAC supply note: lead times for dedicated leases in SG/TK racks are 12–18 weeks if we want specific SKUs. If we rely on short-term rentals for burst, expect higher egress and inter-region traffic.

kevin oneil: cost delta estimates: buy (reserved) = $0.75 / GPU-hour amortized, lease = $1.10 / GPU-hour, spot/short-term = $1.85 / GPU-hour (incl. egress & control plane). For 21d safety converted to reserved commit that's a big CAPEX — finance will push back.

sofia mendoza: tagging finance concerns — we can stretch the commit window across Q3->Q4 but need to cap committed $ at 25% of predicted spend or we lose flexibility. Also want a stress-case number (p95 demand w/ model rollout).

ryan cho: ops idea: keep a 7d warm pool (warm-nodes that can spin up in ~90s) + 21d virtual safety via short-term rental contracts that we only trigger if warm-pool fill > 80%. Saves committed spend while protecting latency.

maria gonzalez: @ryan what's warm-pool delta on latency? We need SLOs intact at 99th percentile for chat gen.

ryan cho: warm-pool warmup adds ~30ms median for first token if cache cold, 99th stays within SLO if pool size >= 10% of baseline concurrency. Need to instrument KV-cache priming.

capacity-bot: DAILY_CAP_REPORT: 2026-06-02 | avg GPU hours/day last 14d = 37,800 | current reserved coverage = 64% | warm-pool capacity = 2.8k GPU-hours/day equivalent. See /cap-report for details.

ashley park: also flag network egress caps in EU-West-1 — we hit soft limits last holiday test. If we provision more dedicated in EU, we must request increased egress quota now (lead time ~2 weeks).

kevin oneil: recommendation from cost side: commit to a 6-month reserved tranche sized to cover baseline + 3d safety in NA/EU, and hold APAC to rental/warm-pool until we confirm supplier lead times. That reduces immediate cash outlay.

sofia mendoza: finance-bot ran a quick delta: committing to the recommended reserved tranche increases committed expense by ~$2.1M/6mo but reduces variable burn by ~22% vs rentals at current rates. We can phase payment across quarters.

maria gonzalez: operational ask for eng-infra: produce a runbook for triggering short-term rentals (who approves, telemetry thresholds, and supplier list). Also list exact SKU families we want reserved. Can we have a PRD by EOW?

trevor liu: I'll drop a PRD draft and the forecast table. Quick config snippet for monitoring thresholds (promql):

```
avg_over_time(sum(gpu_hours_total) by (region)[24h:1h]) > (baseline_region * 1.20)
```

when true for >2h -> trigger ops alert -> start rental pre-approval flow.

ryan cho: I'd add a KV-cache hit-rate check to avoid false positives from inefficient prompts: if kv_hit_rate < 0.65 then don't trigger rentals until we optimize prompts/model variant.

maria gonzalez: agreed. Last: can we simulate a p95 holiday stress with worst-case model rollout (p50 qps uplift + 20% inference cost delta)? Trevor + Ryan please run and post numbers by Thu.

finance-bot: FYI — running staged simulation will post cost delta snapshot to #fin-models when ready.

kevin oneil: one more note — if we opt for partial quantized variants in winter rollout, hardware mix demand shifts (more A100 -> less H100) which impacts supplier quotes. Call this out in PRD.

maria gonzalez: thanks all. We'll converge on a commit-phasing doc: phase A (baseline + 3d reserved) done by July 1; phase B (expand to 7d reserved or rentals) on Sept 1 based on the simulation. If blockers, escalate to SRE lead. :white_check_mark:
